rotation: A / B / C, fixed to Mon / Wed / Fri. Same three sessions each week so load progression stays readable.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.cue: Stop before your hips curl off the pad. That roll is lumbar flexion.

exercises.name: Seated cable row
exercises.cue: Torso stays still. Pull with the back, not by rocking.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
exercises.cue: Stop 1-2 reps short. Dumbbells you can bail on, so push these.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.cue: Low back pinned to the floor the whole set. This is the anti-lordosis work.

exercises.name: Dumbbell curl
exercises.cue: Elbows stay at your sides. No swinging from the hips.

exercises.name: Barbell RDL
exercises.cue: Hips back, spine neutral. Stand up to tall, never past it.

exercises.name: Overhead dumbbell press
exercises.cue: Ribs down. If your back arches to finish the rep, the weight is too heavy.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
exercises.cue: Lean back slightly and hold it. Do not rock through the set.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.cue: Tuck the pelvis under. A sagging low back defeats the point.

exercises.name: Triceps pushdown
exercises.cue: Elbows locked to your ribs. Only the forearm moves.

exercises.name: Walking lunge
exercises.cue: Torso upright, front shin near vertical. Do not lean forward.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell press
exercises.cue: Bench at 30 degrees. Higher turns it into a shoulder press.

exercises.name: Single-arm cable row
exercises.cue: Let the shoulder blade travel. Full stretch at the front.

exercises.name: Face pull
exercises.cue: Pull to the eyebrows, elbows high. Light weight, this is postural.

exercises.name: Standing calf raise
exercises.cue: Full stretch at the bottom, pause at the top. No bouncing.

optional_addins.title: Add-in: Hips and posture
optional_addins.when: Any off day. 12 minutes. The one that actually moves the lordosis.

exercises.name: Couch stretch
exercises.cue: Squeeze the back glute to tuck the pelvis. That is the stretch.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.cue: Stop at a straight line. Do not arch past it.

exercises.name: Bird dog
exercises.cue: Hips stay square. Slow beats far.

exercises.name: Pallof press
exercises.cue: Resist the twist. Nothing rotates.

optional_addins.title: Add-in: Arms and shoulders
optional_addins.when: Saturday flex day. 20 minutes if you have the energy, skip it if you do not.

exercises.name: Cable lateral raise
exercises.cue: Lead with the elbow, stop at shoulder height.

exercises.name: Hammer curl
exercises.cue: Neutral grip the whole way. Hits the brachialis.

exercises.name: Overhead dumbbell extension
exercises.cue: Ribs down, elbows in. Do not arch to get under the weight.

exercises.name: Face pull
exercises.cue: Free postural volume. Almost impossible to overdo.

note: First real program. Two weeks of technique and honest difficulty logging before the numbers mean anything. Every exercise carries substitutions because equipment at EOS Orem gets occupied.
